problem_restatement: Determine whether new prospective evidence justifies reopening the previously rejected HYPE-native long replacement while V57 executes the compression-alignment baseline.

prior_decision_context.interpretation: The new proxy lifecycle is not pooled into the exact prior total because exact mark-trigger, funding, and private-fill evidence are unavailable. Its direction and economics nevertheless reinforce rather than falsify the prior rejection.

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: The latest exit is a sampled executable-BBO proxy, not proof of a venue mark trigger or private fill.
Funding is not attached to the two-lifecycle observer summary.
Two observer lifecycles and three prior exact lifecycles remain too sparse to identify durable HYPE expectancy.
V57 avoiding this one modeled loss does not prove that its stricter entry route is profitable.
A future market regime or a materially different preregistered mechanism can produce different results.

validation.static_checks: Ruff check and format clean; touched files satisfy 500-line file and 50-line function limits
validation.watcher_restart_verification: Two consecutive unchanged-state real-ledger cycles exited zero without duplicate snapshot publication

recommendation.1_recommendation: Keep the HYPE-native long replacement rejected and continue collecting exact long and short lifecycles for the active V57 compression-alignment route.
recommendation.2_why_now: A new post-decision observer lifecycle is resolved and materially updates the previously sparse forward record.
recommendation.3_evidence_reviewed: The immutable two-lifecycle native snapshot, exact V57 live prefix, prior three-lifecycle final disposition, current checkpoint, and current improvement digest.
recommendation.4_observed_problem_or_opportunity: The native mechanism admitted another long against a short breakout and stopped out at the sampled executable BBO; V57 withheld the same setup.
recommendation.5_applicable_market_regime: The observed HYPE 5-minute BREAKOUT / 15-minute RANGE state with hourly structural long and completed 5-minute breakout short.
recommendation.6_alternatives: Restore native long, restore native bidirectional, loosen V57 compression, keep V57 unchanged, or design a distinct preregistered mechanism. The first three are unsupported by current evidence.
recommendation.8_expected_upside: Avoid reopening a negative and directionally fragile candidate while preserving current-source evidence collection.
recommendation.9_main_risks: V57 may remain too sparse or unprofitable; rejecting the native candidate can forgo future winners; proxy evidence lacks venue mark and private-fill truth.
recommendation.10_validation_completed: Exact candidate/baseline attribution, sampled finite-depth path resolution, prior exact decision reconciliation, watcher TDD, and live V57 health reconciliation.
recommendation.11_validation_still_required: Attributable eligible and fully resolved V57 HYPE lifecycles for both configured directions with fees, funding, slippage, stop behavior, latency, excursion, and largest-winner sensitivity.
recommendation.12_success_metrics: Positive after-cost V57 HYPE evidence by side, positive net excluding the largest winner, complete technical paths, and no source-contract mismatch.
recommendation.13_failure_or_rollback_triggers: No rollback applies because no live change is proposed. Reopen the native hypothesis only if a predeclared independent exact-source window is positive after costs and after removing its largest winner, or a materially different mechanism is specified before results.
recommendation.14_confidence: Medium confidence that the new evidence reinforces rejection; low confidence about durable HYPE profitability because all compatible samples remain small.

hypothesis_decision.decision_reason: The new sampled-BBO lifecycle lost, the two-lifecycle observer summary is 0W/2L, and the prior exact three-lifecycle candidate was already negative and largest-winner dependent.
hypothesis_decision.reopen_condition: A preregistered independent exact-source window is positive after all costs and after removing its largest winner, or a materially different mechanism is proposed before observing results.

next_investigation.minimum_evidence_to_update_diagnosis: At least one attributable eligible signal and one fully resolved lifecycle for each configured direction, long and short.

claim_falsifiers: Exact mark and funding reconstruction materially changes either new lifecycle from a loss to a cost-inclusive winner.
The V57 live prefix does not contain the same HYPE decision time and blocker attribution.
A predeclared independent native window becomes positive after costs and remains positive without its largest winner.
A later source audit finds candidate or baseline feature parity was false.
